info.title: Peal API
info.description: Schedule posts across social platforms, follow how they did, and manage a Peal workspace's channels, media and members.

get.description: Answers as soon as the server is up, whatever the state of its database. Use it as a liveness or container health check.
get.summary: Check that the server is up

204.description: The server and its database both answer.

503.description: The server cannot reach its database.

get.description: Answers once the server can reach its database, and fails with DatabaseUnavailable while it cannot. Use it as a readiness check before sending traffic.
get.summary: Check that the server can take traffic

post.description: Starts connecting an account of the platform: answers with the platform's sign-in page, where the browser goes next. The connection is tied to the caller and the workspace, and must be completed within 15 minutes. On a server that bills, a workspace whose plan allows no more channels gets PlanLimitReached. Needs channel:connect.

post.description: Completes a connection with what the platform sent back: the account becomes a channel of the workspace, or the channel it reconnects takes its new tokens. When the sign-in reached several accounts, as the Pages a Facebook user manages, the answer lists them instead, to choose with chooseAccounts. Only the member who started the connection can complete it, once. A new account needs room in the workspace's plan (PlanLimitReached). Needs channel:connect.

post.description: Connects the accounts the member chose among those a completed sign-in listed: each becomes a channel of the workspace, or reconnects the one it has. The new accounts chosen need room in the workspace's plan, all of them: otherwise none is connected (PlanLimitReached), and the choice can be made again with fewer. Only the member who completed the sign-in can choose, within 15 minutes, and once an account is connected: a choice that failed before connecting any can be made again. Needs channel:connect.

post.description: Creates a draft for some of the workspace's channels, possibly none yet, with options on those whose platform takes them (`TargetOptions`, of the channel's platform). Its media must be the workspace's, and ready. Its text, media and options are checked against each platform's rules when it is scheduled, not before. Needs post:create, channel:read, and media:read when it shows media.

Offsets such as +01:00 are refused. | The post's content breaks the rules of its channels' platforms: `violations` says how, channel by channel, for its images and videos, media by media, and for its options on a channel, option by option (`field`). | Some channels asked for are not connected to the workspace: `channelIds` lists them. | Some media attached are not the workspace's, or not ready to show: `mediaIds` lists them.

post.description: Schedules a draft on some of the workspace's channels at an instant, kept with the IANA time zone it was chosen in. The content must fit each platform's rules, its media included: file types, sizes, durations, dimensions, alt text, how many videos, and whether images and videos go together. A channel whose platform takes options needs those it requires, as the draft gives them on that channel: a channel the draft was not for has none yet. A time up to a minute ago publishes now. On a server that bills, the posts going out in that month (UTC) must fit the workspace's plan (PlanLimitReached). Needs post:schedule and channel:read, and media:read when it shows media.

On a server that bills, the members and the other pending invitations must leave room in the workspace's plan (PlanLimitReached). Needs invitation:create, and a member in person: not an API key, nor staff impersonating one.

Counts are read from the platforms every hour for 48 hours after a post goes live, then every day until it is 30 days old. Needs analytics:read.

Permission.description: One action on one resource of a workspace.

Platform.description: A social network a channel connects to.

TargetOptions.description: What a post says on a channel that only its platform knows, tagged by `platform`. Platforms without options take none.

TextUnit.description: How a platform measures the length of a post's text.

TikTokOptions.description: How a post goes out on a TikTok account. Scheduling needs `privacyLevel`.

YouTubeOptions.description: How a post goes out on a YouTube channel. Scheduling needs `title` and `madeForKids`.

NonFiniteNumber.description: A number JSON cannot hold: infinity, negative infinity or not a number.

bearer.description: An API key of a workspace, starting with peal_.
